subject: Taktic: keyproof validation & sampling plan (SIG/SOC2)
messages:
From: Anita Sharma <anita@takticsec.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@takticsec.com
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: SIG/SOC2 on-boarding: BYOK validation & sampling request

Marcus / Redwood team,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As we prepare the SIG and SOC2 intake, our compliance team needs a short sampling plan and evidence package for customer-managed keys (BYOK) and HSM usage. Specifically we need: 

- A proposed sampling schedule for key rotation logs (past 12 months) and a short justification of selection criteria
- HSM attestation or vendor report for the hardware where tenant wrapping keys are stored
- A validated checklist of where keys are in transit (TLS versions, cipher suites) and at-rest (disk/database encryption)
- One example export (anonymized) of a rotation audit row and the associated runbook excerpt explaining emergency rotation

Can you send a single zip or point us to a secure location by EOD tomorrow? If it helps, we can take a 30-min session Wed to walk through the artifacts.

Best,
Anita Sharma
Senior Security Engineer | Taktic Analytics
security@takticsec.com

---
Note: We are running this against SIG v4 baseline; if there are any CAIQ mappings you prefer to call out explicitly, flag them in the package.
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Sharma <anita@takticsec.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/SOC2 on-boarding: BYOK validation & sampling request

Anita — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide that. High-level proposal below and I'll loop in ops to stage artifacts: 

- Sampling plan: quarterly sampling of rotations over last 12 months; select two production tenants and one ephemeral test tenant (criteria: rotation frequency, tenancy age, and whether rotation was manual vs automated).
- HSM attestation: we will provide the vendor attestation PDF and the HSM role matrix excerpt.
- Transit/At-rest: checklist (TLS 1.2+ enforced, AEAD ciphers for tunnels, AES-256 at rest with envelope encryption).
- Example export: we will include an anonymized CSV row with rotation_id, key_id (hashed), timestamp, actor_id (redacted), rationale, and runbook snippet showing emergency key rotation steps.

Attached: redwood-byok-checklist.pdf (draft), evidence-sample-index.xlsx (index of files we'll drop), proposed schedule.

Irene / Laura — can you confirm we can upload the rotation logs and attestation to a secure bucket and share a short read-only link to Anita by EOD tomorrow? If not, propose alternatives.

Marcus
VP, Customer Security | Redwood Inference


From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: ACTIONS — taktIC SIG sampling artifacts (follow up)

Irene / Laura — small checklist so we don't miss anything before we send to Taktic: 

1) Export: kms-rotation-log-2025.csv (anonymize principal IDs; keep rotation_id and timestamp) — Laura to run export and drop to secure bucket.
2) HSM attestation: hsm-attestation-2025.pdf — Irene, confirm vendor report + any VPD / certificate.
3) Runbook excerpt: emergency-rotation.md (one page) — Marcus will draft.
4) Checklist: finalize redwood-byok-checklist.pdf (I left comments on section 3: key wrapping algorithms).
5) Share link + S3 presigned or Drive read-only link in the email to Anita.

Please update the shared Sheet I attached earlier with target times. I put a placeholder slot Wed 09:30 PT for a 30-min runthrough.

Thanks — let's aim to have everything staged by 05:00 PM PT tomorrow.

-Marcus

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 14:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: ACTIONS — taktIC SIG sampling artifacts (follow up)

Heads up — I pulled the attestation and did the minimal redaction. HSM vendor report + cert chain are uploaded to the secure evidence bucket.

Links:
- Evidence bucket (read-only share): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_sample_bucket
- File: hsm-attestation-2025.pdf (vendor-signed; PII removed)
- File: kms-rotation-log-2025.csv (anonymized) — note: rotation actor IDs hashed with salt; timestamps preserved.

I validated that envelope wrapping uses AES-GCM (AES-256-GCM) and that transit enforces TLS1.3 for inter-service calls; noted one older internal integration that still allowed TLS1.2 — added a remediation note to the index.

If Anita wants a short call to walk through the attestation, I can join Wed 09:30 PT.

Irene
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Anita Sharma <anita@takticsec.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@takticsec.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/SOC2 on-boarding: BYOK validation & sampling request

Marcus / Irene,

Received — thanks for the quick turnaround and the links. I spot-checked the CSV and the attestation; the hash-only actor IDs are fine for our audit (we just need consistent correlation ids). The remediation note about TLS1.2 is helpful — please include timeline for mitigation in the package.

Wed 09:30 PT works. I'll invite our compliance manager (Nate) and we'll run through the attestation and the sampling justification. After that call we'll confirm whether Taktic requires any further samples or an expanded rolling-window pull.

Appreciate the responsiveness,
Anita
Senior Security Engineer | Taktic Analytics
security@takticsec.com
